planning.basis: measured on the delivered baseline release

elite-online.curation_policy_version: elite-online/2026.11-r1 (both>=2200 or 2400+2000, no bullet/ultrabullet, no casual, standard variant, min 6 plies)

planning.basis: measured on the delivered baseline release

sources.eligibility: Lichess official broadcasts. Contains both over-the-board and online events; only records passing the codb Masters OTB policy (FIDE rating thresholds, standard chess, online-event exclusion) enter masters-otb.
sources.notes: Broadcast TimeControl strings have inconsistent units. No explicit OTB flag exists in the PGN; OTB qualification relies on event, site and broadcast-slug markers and cannot be proven for every record.

sources.eligibility: Lichess standard rated games (online). Entire archive is online play; Elite policy: both >=2200 or one >=2400 and the other >=2000 Glicko-2, no bullet/ultrabullet, no casual, min 6 plies.
sources.notes: Complete monthly archive, full SHA-256 verified. Quarterly months of 2016 chosen so qualifying games span the year; ratings reflect 2016 Lichess rating inflation and are Glicko-2, not FIDE Elo.
